research_notes: Initial review 2026-10-01. Frozen roster preserved; research spans early legal work, court, political staff, US fellowship, academic work, Treasury, writing and study.

Important overlap resolution: Treasury was two separated periods, not all of 2008–09; ANU umbrella must be reconciled with these and Michigan before any public/private total. Six-month duration is not evidence of full-time work.

Follow-up: obtain accessible complete CV and historical ANU staff/annual reports; establish workload, control, leave, professor promotion/departure and other visiting appointments (Melbourne, NYU, Research Institute of Industrial Economics). Index-only details remain explicitly qualified.

Follow-up: firm-specific dates for Coleman & Grieg, Minter and Clifford; distinguish clerkship/student work; court appointment contract or contemporaneous biography for hours; PPI pay/status/control; Harvard study versus employment; author contracts and party/community governance if any.

Searched own biography/speeches, IZA/CV, Harvard alumni, legal professional press, author profile, historical association annual report and workload queries. CV web retrieval timed out (400); alternate upload URL unavailable and direct curl returned (22) HTTP 502. Source errors did not block other research. The 2006 Academy report indexed a Leigh biography but live PDF text did not match; not relied on.
No full-time status or zero experience inferred from senior titles, scholarships, affiliation or missing biography entries. All headline totals remain null pending evidence.

Follow-up2026-10-02: indexed personal CV resolves firm-specific Clifford Chance year and explicit Minter part/full-time split, and dates IFN visit. All index-only evidence clearly labelled. Direct old CV returned502, alternate unavailable, ordinary curl returned22HTTP502. No access bypass.

Minter status subspells are portions of preserved umbrella, not additive jobs. Same-year full-time component lacks months/days and overlaps Kirby chronology; no duration totals justified. IFN visit is documented affiliation, not presumed paid employment.

Remaining leads: retrieve complete CV or primary appointment records; reconcile court/Cook/Clifford chronology, ANU promotion/exit/leave/control, NYU/Melbourne visit dates, doctoral funding versus paid work, PPI salary and author contracts. Search results giving lecture dates are not visiting-employment dates.

Follow-up 2026-10-04: repeated exact-phrase searches against both published CV locations for Coleman & Grieg, Clifford Chance, New York University and University of Melbourne. Results did not expose additional CV text or primary appointment records; the live personal biography still says only that he was an ANU professor before election. The existing index-only chronology is retained without inventing visit dates, paid status, ANU workload or departure boundaries.
